questions.question: Kubernetes control plane'ning asosiy komponentlari qanday?
questions.explanation: kube-apiserver: markaziy REST API va validatsiya; etcd bilan faqat u gaplashadi.

questions.question: Worker node'ning asosiy komponentlari qanday?
questions.explanation: kubelet: node agent — API server'dan PodSpec'larni kuzatadi va CRI runtime'ga container ishga tushirishni buyuradi.

questions.question: `etcd` ichki tuzilishi va consistency'ni qanday saqlaydi?
questions.explanation: Raft consensus'ini amalga oshiruvchi distributed key-value store (MVCC, revision'lar). Quorum uchun toq sonli node (3 yoki 5): ⌊N/2⌋ + 1. Yozuvlar avval WAL'ga yoziladi va majority tasdiqlagach commit qilinadi — linea...

questions.question: Kubernetes Pod nima?
questions.explanation: Eng kichik deploy birligi: bir yoki bir nechta container, bir xil Network namespace (IP va port maydoni), IPC namespace va umumiy volume'larni bo'lishadi.

questions.question: Pause (infra) container nima?
questions.explanation: Har pod'da birinchi ishga tushadigan va cheksiz uxlaydigan minimal container: umumiy Network, IPC, UTS namespace'larini ushlab turadi. Ilova container'lari uning namespace'iga qo'shiladi — shuning uchun localhost orqa...

questions.question: Deployment, ReplicaSet va Pod farqi.
questions.explanation: Pod: container'larning ishlab turgan nusxasi.

questions.question: StatefulSet nima va Deployment'dan farqi?
questions.explanation: Stateful ilovalar uchun:

questions.question: DaemonSet nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha (yoki tanlangan) node'larda aynan bitta pod nusxasini ishlatadi — node agentlari uchun (CNI, Fluent Bit, node_exporter).

questions.question: Job va CronJob farqi.
questions.explanation: Job: pod(lar) yaratib, belgilangan soni muvaffaqiyatli tugashini ta'minlaydi (run-to-completion).

questions.question: Kubernetes Service turlari (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName) qanday?
questions.explanation: ClusterIP (default): faqat klaster ichida ichki IP.

questions.question: Headless Service (`clusterIP: None`) nima?
questions.explanation: ClusterIP ajratmaydi; CoreDNS barcha pod IP'larining A yozuvlarini qaytaradi — client'lar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pod'larga ulanadi (StatefulSet, Kafka, Cassandra).

questions.question: Ingress va Ingress Controller farqi.
questions.explanation: Ingress: L7 HTTP/HTTPS routing qoidalari, TLS termination, host/path bo'yicha marshrutlash — deklarativ API resurs.

questions.question: Kubernetes Gateway API nima?
questions.explanation: Ingress'ning zamonaviy vorisi, rollarga ajratilgan resurslar:

questions.question: Namespace'lar va ularning izolyatsiya chegaralari qanday?
questions.explanation: Fizik klaster ichidagi virtual klasterlar: obyekt nomlari, RBAC va ResourceQuota uchun mantiqiy doira. Default'da tarmoq izolyatsiyasi yo'q (NetworkPolicy kerak) va xavfsizlik chegarasi to'liq emas.

questions.question: ConfigMap va Secret farqi.
questions.explanation: ConfigMap: maxfiy bo'lmagan konfiguratsiya (env yoki fayl sifatida).

questions.question: PersistentVolume (PV) va PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) farqi.
questions.explanation: PV: admin yoki StorageClass yaratgan storage resursi (masalan EBS volume).

questions.question: Dynamic provisioning (StorageClass) nima?
questions.explanation: PVC StorageClass ga ishora qilsa, Kubernetes CSI orqali cloud volume'ni (masalan gp3) avtomatik yaratadi. volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer AZ moslashmasligining oldini oladi.

questions.question: Storage access mode'lari qanday?
questions.explanation: RWO: bitta node'da read-write.

questions.question: ServiceAccount nima?
questions.explanation: Pod'larning API Server'ga autentifikatsiya qilishi uchun identity. Zamonaviy Kubernetes'da token qisqa muddatli, projected volume orqali mount qilinadi (/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token); kerak bo'l...

questions.question: RBAC: Role, ClusterRole, RoleBinding, ClusterRoleBinding farqi.
questions.explanation: Role: bitta namespace'da API ruxsatlari (get, list, create).

questions.question: Admission controller nima?
questions.explanation: Autentifikatsiya va avtorizatsiyadan keyin, obyekt etcd ga yozilishidan oldin so'rovni ushlovchi plugin'lar.

questions.question: Liveness, readiness va startup probe farqi.
questions.explanation: Startup: sekin ishga tushadigan ilova start bo'ldimi; o'tguncha liveness/readiness o'chiq.

questions.question: Init container nima?
questions.explanation: Asosiy container'lardan oldin ketma-ket ishlab tugaydigan container'lar — DB'ni kutish, migration, konfiguratsiya tayyorlash uchun.

questions.question: Ephemeral container nima?
questions.explanation: Ishlab turgan pod'ga restart'siz debug uchun qo'shiladigan vaqtinchalik container (kubectl debug -it pod --image=busybox --target=app).

questions.question: Pod Disruption Budget (PDB) nima?
questions.explanation: Ixtiyoriy uzilishlarda (node drain, upgrade) bir vaqtda nechta replika mavjud bo'lmasligi mumkinligini cheklovchi siyosat (minAvailable / maxUnavailable).

questions.question: Resource requests va limits farqi.
questions.explanation: Requests: pod uchun kafolatlangan minimal CPU/xotira; scheduler joylashtirishda ishlatadi.

questions.question: Kubernetes QoS klasslari qanday?
questions.explanation: Guaranteed: har container'da CPU va xotira request = limit. Eng oxirida evict qilinadi.

questions.question: Node affinity va pod anti-affinity nima?
questions.explanation: Node affinity: pod qaysi node'larga tushishini label bo'yicha cheklaydi (required... qat'iy yoki preferred... afzal).

questions.question: Taint va toleration nima?
questions.explanation: Taint: node'ga qo'yiladi va pod'larni itaradi (key=value:NoSchedule, NoExecute).

questions.question: Topology spread constraints nima?
questions.explanation: Pod'larni failure domain'lar (AZ, rack, node) bo'ylab label selector bilan teng taqsimlash qoidalari (maxSkew: 1, topologyKey).

questions.question: Kubelet eviction manager nima?
questions.explanation: Node xotira, disk va PID'ini kuzatadi; chegaradan oshganda (memory.available < 100Mi) node yiqilmasligi uchun past prioritetli pod'larni evict qiladi.

questions.question: PriorityClass va preemption nima?
questions.explanation: Pod'larning nisbiy ahamiyati (value: 1000000). Yuqori prioritetli pod resurs yo'qligidan joylasha olmasa, scheduler past prioritetli pod'larni evict (preempt) qiladi.

questions.question: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) nima?
questions.explanation: CPU/xotira yoki custom/external metrikaga ko'ra replika sonini avtomatik o'zgartiradigan control loop (request'lar qo'yilgan bo'lishi shart).

questions.question: Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) nima?
questions.explanation: Tarixiy foydalanishga ko'ra CPU/xotira request va limit'larini tavsiya qiladigan yoki avtomatik yangilaydigan controller (bir xil metrika bo'yicha HPA bilan birga ishlatmang).

questions.question: KEDA nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi event manbalari (Kafka consumer lag, SQS, RabbitMQ, Prometheus) bo'yicha workload'ni 0 dan yuzlabgacha scale qiladigan autoscaler.

questions.question: Karpenter nima?
questions.explanation: AWS yaratgan ochiq node autoscaler: ASG'larni chetlab, pending pod'larga mos EC2'larni EC2 Fleet API orqali soniyalarda yaratadi.

questions.question: Karpenter consolidation nima?
questions.explanation: Karpenter doimiy isrofni baholab, kam yuklangan node'lardan pod'larni ko'chiradi va ularni arzonroq/kichikroq instance bilan almashtiradi yoki o'chiradi.

questions.question: Cluster Autoscaler (CA) nima?
questions.explanation: Pod'lar Pending bo'lganda ASG desired capacity'sini o'zgartirib node qo'shadi yoki bo'sh node'larni olib tashlaydigan an'anaviy autoscaler.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da CoreDNS nima?
questions.explanation: Ichki servis nomlarini (my-svc.my-ns.svc.cluster.local) va tashqi domenlarni pod'lar uchun resolve qiladigan klaster DNS serveri.

questions.question: NodeLocal DNSCache nima?
questions.explanation: Har node'da lokal DNS cache agentini ishlatadigan DaemonSet — CoreDNS'ga so'rovlar, conntrack/UDP paket yo'qolishi va ndots:5 sababli latency kamayadi.

questions.question: Endpoints va EndpointSlice API farqi.
questions.explanation: Endpoints: servis ortidagi barcha pod IP'larini saqlaydigan monolit obyekt; 5000 pod'li servisda bitta pod o'zgarsa butun obyekt qayta yozilib etcd va tarmoqqa yuk bo'ladi.

questions.question: `kube-proxy` IPVS va iptables rejimi farqi.
questions.explanation: iptables: qoidalar ketma-ket (O(N)) — servislar minglab bo'lsa sekinlashadi va yangilash qimmat.

questions.question: Cilium eBPF CNI nima?
questions.explanation: kube-proxy va iptables o'rniga kernel'ga yuklangan eBPF dasturlaridan foydalanadigan CNI: O(1) routing, L7 ko'rinish, NetworkPolicy, shaffof shifrlash (WireGuard/IPsec).

questions.question: NetworkPolicy nima?
questions.explanation: Label selector'lar bilan pod'lar orasidagi L3/L4 trafikni boshqaradigan deklarativ firewall resursi (CNI qo'llashi kerak).

questions.question: Default-deny NetworkPolicy nima?
questions.explanation: Namespace'dagi barcha pod'larni tanlab, bo'sh ingress/egress qoidalari bilan barcha trafikni yopadigan policy — keyin kerakli oqimlar aniq ochiladi (DNS egress'ni unutmang).

questions.question: Pod Security Admission (PSA) nima?
questions.explanation: Eski PodSecurityPolicy o'rnini bosgan ichki mexanizm: namespace label'lari bilan uchta profil (Privileged, Baseline, Restricted) ni enforce/audit/warn rejimlarida majburlaydi.

questions.question: OPA Gatekeeper nima?
questions.explanation: Rego'da yozilgan tashkilot siyosatlarini Kubernetes manifest'lariga majburlaydigan admission controller.

questions.question: Kyverno nima?
questions.explanation: Sof YAML'da yoziladigan Kubernetes-native policy engine: resurslarni validate, mutate, generate qiladi va image imzosini tekshiradi.

questions.question: Helm va Helm hook'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes paket menejeri. Hook'lar (pre-install, post-upgrade, pre-delete) reliz lifecycle'ining ma'lum nuqtalarida job (masalan DB migration) bajarish imkonini beradi.

questions.question: Helm dependency boshqaruvi (`Chart.lock`) qanday?
questions.explanation: Subchart'lar Chart.yaml da e'lon qilinadi, aniq versiya va digest'lar Chart.lock da qotiriladi (helm dependency update/build).

questions.question: `values.schema.json` nima?
questions.explanation: Chart ichidagi JSON Schema — foydalanuvchi values.yaml ini template render qilishdan oldin validatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: Kustomize nima?
questions.explanation: kubectl ga o'rnatilgan (kubectl apply -k) shablonsiz moslash vositasi: base YAML ustiga deklarativ overlay'lar.

questions.question: Kustomize strategic merge patch nima?
questions.explanation: Overlay YAML bloklarini base manifest'ga resurs nomi va key'lar bo'yicha birlashtirish (array'ni to'liq ustidan yozmasdan, masalan container nomi bo'yicha merge).

questions.question: CRD (Custom Resource Definition) nima?
questions.explanation: API'ni kengaytirish mexanizmi: custom obyekt turlarini (kind: KafkaTopic) e'lon qilish — API Server ularni nativ resurs kabi saqlaydi va boshqaradi.

questions.question: Operator pattern nima?
questions.explanation: CRD va custom control loop birikmasi: holatni kuzatib, domenga xos avtomatlashtirishni bajaradi (DB failover, backup).

questions.question: Operator Framework / Kubebuilder nima?
questions.explanation: Production operator'lar yozish uchun Go SDK va scaffolding: kod generatsiya, webhook handler'lar, controller-runtime.

questions.question: Controller'larda leader election nima?
questions.explanation: coordination.k8s.io Lease obyektlari orqali bir vaqtda controller'ning faqat bitta replikasi reconcile qilishini ta'minlovchi mexanizm.

questions.question: etcd compaction va defragmentation nima?
questions.explanation: Compaction: eski revision tarixini o'chiradi.

questions.question: Kubernetes API versiyalari (`v1alpha1`, `v1beta1`, `v1`) qanday?
questions.explanation: alpha: default o'chiq, eksperimental, ogohlantirishsiz olib tashlanishi mumkin.

questions.question: Kubernetes deprecation policy qanday?
questions.explanation: GA API'lar major versiya ichida olib tashlanmaydi; beta API'lar deprecation'dan keyin kamida 9 oy yoki 3 minor reliz qo'llab-quvvatlanadi. Upgrade'dan oldin deprecated API'larni (pluto, kubent) tekshiring.

questions.question: API Server aggregation layer nima?
questions.explanation: Asosiy API Server ortida mustaqil qo'shimcha API serverlarni (masalan Metrics Server) ro'yxatdan o'tkazib API'ni kengaytirish.

questions.question: Metrics Server nima?
questions.explanation: Kubelet'lardan CPU/xotira ma'lumotini yig'adigan xotiradagi aggregator — kubectl top va HPA ishlatadi (monitoring tizimi emas).

questions.question: Prometheus Operator nima?
questions.explanation: CRD'lar (ServiceMonitor, PrometheusRule) bilan Prometheus stack'ini Kubernetes'da deploy va boshqarishni avtomatlashtiradigan operator.

questions.question: `ServiceMonitor` nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes Service label'lari va endpoint'lari bo'yicha Prometheus scrape target'larini topib sozlaydigan CRD.

questions.question: External Secrets Operator (Kubernetes kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: AWS Secrets Manager, Vault kabi tizimlardan secret'larni nativ Secret ga sinxronlaydigan operator (refresh interval bilan).

questions.question: cert-manager nima?
questions.explanation: Let's Encrypt, Vault va private PKI'dan TLS sertifikatlarini avtomatik chiqarish va yangilash uchun Kubernetes add-on.

questions.question: Kubernetes garbage collection (cascading deletion) nima?
questions.explanation: Egasi (Deployment) o'chirilganda ownerReferences orqali bog'liq child'lar (ReplicaSet, Pod) avtomatik o'chiriladi (--cascade=orphan bilan saqlab qolish mumkin).

questions.question: Kubernetes finalizer nima?
questions.explanation: Metadata'dagi pre-delete hook: tashqi tozalash (cloud storage'ni bo'shatish) tugamaguncha obyekt etcd'dan o'chirilmaydi.

questions.question: DaemonSet rolling update strategiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: RollingUpdate va maxUnavailable: 1 — pod'lar node'lar bo'ylab birma-bir yangilanadi (maxSurge ham qo'llanadi).

questions.question: Node drain va cordon farqi.
questions.explanation: Cordon: node'ni unschedulable qiladi; mavjud pod'lar ishlayveradi.

questions.question: `kubectl exec` va `kubectl attach` farqi.
questions.explanation: exec: container ichida yangi process ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: `kubectl port-forward` nima?
questions.explanation: Lokal port'dan klaster ichidagi pod yoki Service portiga API server orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri TCP tunnel.

questions.question: Mutating webhook failure policy (`Ignore` va `Fail`) farqi.
questions.explanation: Ignore: webhook javob bermasa resurs baribir qabul qilinadi.

questions.question: `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` nima?
questions.explanation: SIGTERM dan keyin pod'ga toza to'xtash uchun beriladigan vaqt (default 30s); tugamasa SIGKILL. preStop vaqti ham shu davr ichiga kiradi.

questions.question: `preStop` lifecycle hook nima?
questions.explanation: SIGTERM yuborilishidan oldin container ichida bajariladigan skript yoki HTTP chaqiruv — graceful drain'ni boshlash (endpoint'lar yangilanishini kutish uchun sleep).

questions.question: Server-Side Apply (SSA) nima?
questions.explanation: API Server managedFields orqali qaysi YAML maydoniga qaysi controller/user egalik qilishini kuzatadi — tasodifiy ustidan yozishning oldi olinadi va konflikt aniq ko'rinadi.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da `subPath` volume mount nima?
questions.explanation: Butun volume emas, uning ichidagi bitta papka yoki faylni container yo'liga mount qilish. Eslatma: subPath bilan mount qilingan ConfigMap avtomatik yangilanmaydi.

questions.question: Projected volume nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta manbani (Secret, ConfigMap, DownwardAPI, ServiceAccountToken) bitta papkaga birlashtirib mount qilish.

questions.question: Downward API nima?
questions.explanation: Pod va container metadata'sini (pod IP, node nomi, namespace, limit'lar) ilovaga env yoki fayl sifatida uzatish.

questions.question: Kubernetes Event (`kubectl get events`) nima?
questions.explanation: Lifecycle o'zgarishlari, scheduling qarorlari, ogohlantirish va xatolarni yozadigan qisqa muddatli yozuvlar (default ~1 soat saqlanadi) — uzoq saqlash uchun eksport qiling.
